canonical_project: EcoCloud Olkaria Project Eagle (KenGen Green Energy Park)
owner: EcoCloud Data Centre; KenGen Green Energy Park host (with KenGen, Konza Technopolis, G42 collaboration)
notes: EcoCloud broke ground on Project Eagle at KenGen Green Energy Park, Olkaria (Nakuru County) in Sept 2023: phase one 24 MW IT capacity across eight 3MW data halls (300-500 racks each), expected total consumption ~70 MW, geothermal power from KenGen; $600M project coverage Sep 2025. NOTE: 2026 reporting (Ghanamma 2026-07-17) describes the site as largely empty with the broader Microsoft/G42 1GW ambition stalled - treat construction progress as uncertain (B for ground-breaking; current status U).
